description: Engine-neutral collision probe for the hallway checks in hallways.md. These are demonstration choices for probing collision boundaries, not a robot model.

probe.drive: speed control, capped at max_speed_m_per_s; no teleporting
probe.controller: gain and force/effort limit are engine-specific and recorded in each result's settings; not part of this contract

source: Values agree with livingproof-sim-mujoco cdf90a8 (hallway-open-0.1.0.mujoco.json, hallway.py _reset) and livingproof-sim-gazebo af2017c (hallway-open-0.1.0.gazebo.json, hallway.py run plan).
